mlSecurityFindings.title: Encryption: AES-128 (ML prediction)
mlSecurityFindings.message: ML model predicts AES-128 encryption (MEDIUM confidence: 73.0%).
mlSecurityFindings.detail: AES-128 provides 128-bit security level. CNSA Suite 2.0 recommends AES-256 for TOP SECRET data. AES-128 remains acceptable for most deployments.
mlSecurityFindings.recommendation: Consider upgrading to AES-256 for highest-assurance deployments.

mlSecurityFindings.title: Integrity: SHA-256 (ML prediction)
mlSecurityFindings.message: ML model predicts SHA-256 integrity algorithm (HIGH confidence: 100.0%).
mlSecurityFindings.detail: SHA-256 is acceptable under RFC 8221. SHA-384 or SHA-512 preferred for CNSA Suite.

mlSecurityFindings.title: Key Exchange: DH Group 14 / MODP-2048 (ML prediction)
mlSecurityFindings.message: ML model predicts DH Group 14 (MODP-2048) (HIGH confidence: 100.0%).
mlSecurityFindings.detail: DH Group 14 (MODP-2048) provides 112-bit security. CNSA Suite 2.0 requires a minimum of DH Group 15 (MODP-3072) or ECDH P-384.
mlSecurityFindings.recommendation: Upgrade to DH Group 15 (MODP-3072) or DH Group 19/20 (ECDH).

mlSecurityFindings.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy: Disabled (ML prediction)
mlSecurityFindings.message: ML model predicts PFS is not in use (HIGH confidence: 100.0%).
mlSecurityFindings.detail: Without PFS, compromise of the long-term IKE SA keys could allow decryption of all past ESP sessions. PFS is required by many compliance frameworks.
mlSecurityFindings.recommendation: Enable PFS using CREATE_CHILD_SA with a new DH exchange (DH Group 14 minimum, Group 15+ recommended).

mlSecurityFindings.title: IKE Handshake Traffic Observed
mlSecurityFindings.detail: IKE handshake metadata (exchange type, SPIs, payload types) is visible in plaintext. Only the payload content within encrypted exchanges is protected.
mlSecurityFindings.recommendation: IKE control-plane visibility is expected. Ensure IKE_AUTH payloads use encryption (payload type 46).

mlSecurityFindings.title: ESP Data Tunnel Active
mlSecurityFindings.message: 40 ESP packet(s) observed — encrypted data tunnel confirmed active.
mlSecurityFindings.detail: ESP (Encapsulating Security Payload) packets provide confidentiality and integrity for the data plane. Inner packet headers are encrypted.
mlSecurityFindings.recommendation: Verify ESP replay window size is configured appropriately.
